summary: Native ROUTE-1 final regrade has 78 open pad pairs, 34 failed_single plus 4 open_single and 61 new dangling findings. Original R5 has zero track/via copper. At unchanged 0.2/0.2/0.6 geometry U30.8 and U18.5 pass local reachability on R5 and are caged on ROUTE-1; U2.12 R5 passes but ROUTE-1 result auto-coarsened and is advisory only. This discriminates generated copper congestion for the two precise sampled escapes, not whole-board feasibility. Bounded experiment alters no immutable design geometry and is accepted only if native connectivity and preservation gates pass.
